RESOLVED: Dear Ms. Whitfield,

Re: Claim CLM-550193 for MRI brain w/o contrast on August 27, 2026

Thank you for reaching out to us about the denial of your claim. We understand that you have questions about the denial reason "prior authorization not on file" and the appeal process.

According to our policy, when a service is denied for "prior authorization not on file", you may file a first-level appeal within 180 days of the denial notice date. Your ordering provider, Dr. L. Okonjo, may submit a retrospective authorization request with clinical documentation supporting medical necessity.

The exact deadline for filing an appeal is 180 days from the denial notice date. We recommend that you discuss this further with your provider and submit the appeal form (FORM-APP-1) along with the required documentation.

If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to reach out to us. We are here to assist you.

Sincerely,
ARIA
Meridian Health Plan Member Services
